Markus — adding frontline notes from sales calls this week. Short bullets: 

- BigCo (Ava Reynolds) raised explicit price-protection asks; they want a 6-month window guaranteeing no lower list pricing for any models deployed. Mentioned they are evaluating CloudCo's pilot. (See attached RFI summary.)
- Two mid-market prospects asking about incremental discounts for reserved capacity; both referenced "usage-based pilot" language.
- Several engineering leads asked about quantized variants — they expect "drop-in" performance, unclear on accuracy delta for long-form summarization.
